GDPR-G-1-PurposeLimitation.evidence: to improve our services and for general business purposes
GDPR-G-1-PurposeLimitation.reason: The document uses vague catch‑all purposes rather than specifying explicit purposes tied to each data category.

GDPR-G-3-LawfulBasis.evidence: By creating an account, you consent to all of the data collection, use, and sharing described in this notice.
GDPR-G-3-LawfulBasis.reason: The notice describes data collection and processing but does not identify specific GDPR Art. 6 lawful bases for each processing activity.

GDPR-G-4-Transparency.evidence: We share your information with our trusted partners and service providers who help us operate the platform.
GDPR-G-4-Transparency.reason: The notice lacks any disclosure of data retention period(s), which the rule requires at collection.

GDPR-G-5-DataSubjectRights.evidence: If you would like to access the personal information we hold about you
GDPR-G-5-DataSubjectRights.reason: The notice only mentions the right of access and does not enumerate rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, objection, or the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

GDPR-G-6-RecordsAndTransfers.evidence: Some of these providers are located in other countries.
GDPR-G-6-RecordsAndTransfers.reason: The notice discloses international data sharing but does not specify any transfer mechanism such as SCCs or an adequacy decision.

GDPR-G-7-SecurityOfProcessing.reason: The document only provides a generic claim about security without specifying concrete technical or organisational measures such as encryption, access controls, or testing.
